title: Ask to be kept by the Will
summary: This meets the moment when self-direction is failing but pride still resists surrender. The line becomes relief by asking to be kept according to the Beloved's pleasure.
takeaway: Hand the outcome back to the Will.
lifeApplication: Before sending the defense, the correction, or the demand, lower the eyes and say the line once. Let the body feel what surrender changes before the mouth speaks.

source.shortMeaning: Peace begins when the self asks to be kept by Hukam.
source.lifeApplication: When pride hardens, ask to be held by the Will before you act.

evidence.coreClaim: Peace begins when the self asks to be kept by Hukam.
evidence.turn: Serve first, and let peace expose the self.
